# Dr. Agnieszka Althaber

> Sociologist and postdoctoral researcher at the Chair "Social Structures and Social Inequality", Department of Sociology, Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität (LMU) Munich, Germany. Research on wealth and social inequalities, gender inequalities, couples and property, life course research, labour market research and occupations, and quantitative research methods.
